stories.title: Tren Buenavista - AIFA sube de precio: ¿Cuánto costará viajar de la CDMX al aeropuerto?; conoce las nuevas tarifas

en.title: Buenavista - AIFA Train increases price: How much will it cost to travel from Mexico City to the airport?; learn the new fares
en.summary: The Buenavista-AIFA train service is raising its ticket prices, though operating schedules will remain unchanged.

stories.title: AT&T lleva 5G, fibra y monitoreo para responder a la alta demanda en estadios

en.title: AT&T brings 5G, fiber and monitoring to respond to high demand in stadiums
en.summary: AT&T is deploying advanced telecommunications infrastructure in stadiums, integrating fiber, spectrum, distributed antennas, artificial intelligence and network segmentation to handle capacity demands.

stories.title: Tren Maya alcanzará punto de equilibrio en 2032; ha transportado a 2.9 millones de pasajeros desde diciembre de 2023

en.title: Mayan Train will reach break-even point in 2032; has transported 2.9 million passengers since December 2023
en.summary: The Mayan Train has carried 2.9 million passengers since its December 2023 launch and generated 541 million pesos in revenue during 2025, with projections to reach financial break-even by 2032.

stories.title: Anne Carson reacciona al Premio Nobel de Literatura; "creo que están todos locos", afirma la poeta

en.title: Anne Carson reacts to Nobel Prize in Literature; "I think they are all crazy", says the poet
en.summary: Poet Anne Carson responded to receiving the Nobel Prize in Literature with a humorous remark expressing incredulity at the award.

stories.title: Peste neumónica: Rusia no detecta "patología infecciosa" tras muerte de mujer; termina seguimiento médico a contactos de la paciente

en.title: Pneumonic plague: Russia detects no "infectious pathology" following woman's death; ends medical monitoring of patient's contacts
en.summary: Russia concluded medical monitoring of all individuals who had contact with a deceased employee of a Siberian plague control institute, finding no infectious pathology in those contacts.

stories.title: EU acusa a Nicolás Maduro de represión y tortura en Venezuela; su esposa Cilia Flores es señalada de narcoterrorismo

en.title: US accuses Nicolás Maduro of repression and torture in Venezuela; his wife Cilia Flores is accused of narcoterrorism
en.summary: The United States accused former Venezuelan president Nicolás Maduro of repression and torture against political opponents, while his wife Cilia Flores was accused of narcoterrorism.

stories.title: Rusia asegura no haber detectado "patología infecciosa" en los contactos de presunto caso de peste

en.title: Russia asserts it has not detected "infectious pathology" in contacts of suspected plague case
en.summary: Russia confirmed that no infectious pathology was detected after monitoring contacts of a Siberian plague control institute employee who died of pneumonia.

stories.title: Maduro y Cilia Flores son acusados en EU por presuntos actos de tortura en Venezuela

en.title: Maduro and Cilia Flores are accused in the US of alleged torture acts in Venezuela
en.summary: Nicolás Maduro and his wife Cilia Flores were accused in the United States of torturing political opponents to maintain control of Venezuela.

stories.title: Acusa EU a Maduro de tortura en nueva imputación

en.title: U.S. Accuses Maduro of Torture in New Indictment
en.summary: U.S. authorities have filed new formal charges against former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro, including accusations of torture and other crimes.

stories.title: Rubio asegura que la guerra entre Rusia y Ucrania se encuentra en un peligroso punto muerto

en.title: Rubio Says Russia-Ukraine War Is at Dangerous Stalemate
en.summary: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated the Russia-Ukraine conflict is in a dangerous deadlock and the U.S. will continue efforts to broker a peace agreement.

stories.title: Estancamiento de guerra en Ucrania puede desembocar en conflicto regional: Rubio; escalada podría incluir sabotaje en países OTAN, alerta

en.title: Ukraine War Stalemate Could Lead to Regional Conflict: Rubio; Escalation Could Include NATO Country Sabotage, Alert
en.summary: Military deadlock in Ukraine may be resolved through negotiation with mutual concessions or through escalation that could involve sabotage in NATO nations, according to warnings.

stories.title: Gana Anne Carson el Nobel de Literatura

en.title: Anne Carson Wins Nobel Prize in Literature
en.summary: Canadian author Anne Carson received the Nobel Prize in Literature for her work that dialogues with classical traditions and creates new forms for contemporary literature.

stories.title: Nissan lanza en México la Frontier PRO PHEV: hecha en China y por menos de 900,000 pesos

en.title: Nissan launches Frontier PRO PHEV in Mexico: made in China and for less than 900,000 pesos
en.summary: Nissan introduced its first plug-in hybrid pickup truck in Mexico, manufactured in China, priced below 900,000 pesos. The model marks Nissan's first vehicle developed and produced in China for global export.

stories.title: ¿Correos de México puede competir con DHL y Estafeta? Así están sus precios y tiempos de entrega

en.title: Can Correos de México compete with DHL and Estafeta? Here are their prices and delivery times
en.summary: A comparison of shipping services from DHL, Estafeta, and Correos de México showed price differences of hundreds of pesos for identical shipments. The analysis examines Correos de México's competitive position against private carriers.

stories.title: El auge de la IA choca con la guerra en el tablero del comercio mundial

en.title: The AI boom clashes with war in the global trade arena
en.summary: Rising energy costs from military conflicts could reduce global trade growth by 0.5 percentage points. Artificial intelligence expansion faces headwinds from geopolitical tensions affecting commerce.

stories.title: Esta es la fecha oficial del Buen Fin 2026 que cambió el calendario y cómo registrar tu negocio

en.title: This is the official date for Buen Fin 2026 that changed the calendar and how to register your business
en.summary: The official date for Buen Fin 2026 was set for November, continuing the established tradition. Information was provided on how businesses can register for the commercial promotion.

stories.title: El IEPS de 8% a videojuegos con violencia continuará en pausa en 2027

en.title: 8% IEPS on violent video games will remain suspended in 2027
en.summary: Mexico's Finance Ministry projects zero revenue from the tax on violent video games for next year, indicating the suspension will continue. A stimulus for National Lottery drawings is also expected to persist.
